scope: Verify whether the current official ODA File Converter macOS ARM64 package can safely replace the locally installed app for the AC1027 Cover suffix experiment.

vendorSource.platformClaim: Mac OS X 13.0 arm64 or later (Apple Chip)

package.gatekeeperResult: Internal error in Code Signing subsystem.

extractedApplication.signatureResult: FAIL: invalid signature (code or signature have been modified), arm64

interpretation.result: The package was fetched from the vendor-linked official ARM64 download route and its extracted app identifies as ODA File Converter 27.9.0.0. Both package validation and strict app-code validation fail locally.
interpretation.disposition: Do not install or run this package. The existing AC1027 suffix remains unresolved; resume the ODA experiment only with a vendor-provided artifact whose package and extracted app pass integrity verification, or another independently verified eligible producer.
interpretation.unrelatedPriorEvidence: The earlier GUI conversion was performed by the already installed 27.1.0.0 app. It rewrote the drawing to AC1032 but did not explain the source suffix.

limitations: No claim is made that ODA's server deliberately distributes altered files; this receipt records only the observed local validation failures.
No software was installed or executed and no drawing was converted.
